purpose: Metadata and PCM-only independent long-input stress preparation; no ASR was run.
scope_note: All 72 source clips are previously evaluated recordings from the old 2,506-record benchmark. This is an additional concatenated confirmation stress set, not unseen data; the appended 24 clips were not used for V6 parameter design.

selection.selection_rule: Exclude all IDs occurring as source components in prior confirmation_long_inputs/plan.json; sort remaining confirmation rows with library_key=topic_06_新闻人物组织地理 by their frozen selection_hash ascending, then ID; take first 48.
selection.grouping_rule: Six sequential groups of eight from the frozen selection order; no domain-specific thresholding or other library changes.
selection.selection_hash_algorithm: Existing frozen SHA-256 selection_hash from frozen_test_plan.json; no reference or gold text used.

library.scope: Use the complete frozen 1,051-enabled-entity snapshot for all six groups. No per-group threshold, entity subset, or library mutation.

additional_selection.selection_algorithm: For each specified library_key, exclude all IDs in the previous frozen 180-row plan and all IDs already used in independent_long_inputs; sort the rest by SHA-256 of UTF-8 `preflight-independent-v6:<id>` ascending (ID tie-break), then take first eight.
additional_selection.selection_basis: Metadata only: fixed hash, library_key, PCM path/hash, duration. No transcript/reference/gold or ASR output used.
additional_selection.parameter_design: These 24 clips were not used to choose or tune V6 parameters.
